strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
We made it in time...!
Grr, just a step too late... But we have you completely surrounded!
We'll crush you along with your base!
Ngh, from all sides...! This will be a tough fight...
True. But that also means the enemy's forces are spread out.
Looks like we'll have to take them out one at a time.
Those jerks! While we were sweating it out in South America,
they snuck in like burglars into an empty house!
Silence, Koji Kabuto!
The Mechanical Beasts you think you beat and we of the Mykene Empire...
...are not to be lumped together!
Bring it on! Don't come crying to me when you lose!
Mykene Empire, my foot. All you do is sneak around while we're away...
Don't make me laugh!
Bark all you like, Tetsuya Tsurugi! Winning is all that matters! Winning!
Then right back at you! As I knock you back into your hole...!
Who'd have thought the Cyber Beast Force base's layout would hurt us...
Having to fight with the reservoir between us...!
Griping won't get us anywhere, Commander!
We're on standby here. How about opening the hatch?
Geez, Mister, that's so pushy!
No, he's right. All right, all units, launch!
Perfect timing. These will be your opponents!
What are you sending out!?
Heh, doesn't matter what comes out.
That's... Great Mazinger!?
...Impossible! How!?
Heh heh heh... Go! Great Mazinger corps!
Scatter the Gandor squad!
No! Great Mazinger is our enemy...? And there are four of them!?
Huh!? No, Sayaka! Those are... Mass-Production Great Mazingers!
Mass-production!?
I've seen the plans... Great General of Darkness, back then...!
What's going on!? How did they get Great Mazinger!?
Tetsuya, don't tell me...!
...I see, back when they pulled out of the Fortress of Science Lab...!
I thought they withdrew awfully fast... So that's what it was!
The Director showed me... Mass-Production Great Mazingers!
Precisely. We took the blueprints! Building them took some effort...
but they are more than enough to crush you!
This is terrible...
A fake is still just a fake...! There's nothing to fear!
Then taste their power for yourself!
Hm, this thing...!
Tetsuya!? What's wrong? We have to attack, quick...!
Something's off...?
I see! These were built exactly the same as Great.
Which means... their ID signals are the same...!
Tetsuya!
That should do it...! Everyone, take these things down! With any luck...!
What did you do?
I synced up their circuits and shorted them out.
Now if we just completely destroy their AI...
Graaah! To think you could wound me this badly...!
Very well, I shall withdraw for today!
...But this is not over!
Tch, quit running your mouth! And don't come back!
Phew, at least we chased off the loudest one.
Geez, why can't they fight fair and come at us head-on!
Spare me your bluster, Great General of Darkness!
He's getting away! Tetsuya!
...Let him go, Jun. I talked big, but we don't have the strength to pursue.
So this is the Far East branch Commander Zuril mentioned...
What? What's that teeny little saucer?
That's...! A Vega Star Federation saucer...!
Comin' in all by itself? Ya got guts.
Commander! More objects are approaching this airspace!
Hold it! You're not getting away!
Daisuke!? Maria!?
Daisuke...?
Heh heh... So you've come, Duke Fleed!
I'll say it once more. Hand over Grendizer.
If you don't, your life can't be saved!
No matter how many times you ask, my answer is the same!
I won't hand Planet Fleed's guardian god to the likes of Vega!
Daisuke!? What does she mean, your life can't be saved!?
Koji! Save my brother! His body's been poisoned by Vegatron radiation!
Vegatron radiation!?
Stop it, Maria!
I won't! My brother... the radiation wound he got escaping Planet Fleed...
has spread all through his body!
N-Nobody told me about that.
He kept it hidden so he wouldn't worry anyone.
No way... You should've told me, Daisuke...
I'm sorry... Koji...
To save him, we need the Vegatron Minus Ray Gun she has.
Got it, Maria. We just have to shoot down that saucer, right?
Yes. Please, lend me your strength!
Maria, what do you mean!? His life can't be saved?
My brother's body has been poisoned by Vegatron radiation!
Vegatron radiation?
The radiation wound keeps spreading through his body...
Th-This is the first I've heard of it...
He kept quiet so he wouldn't worry everyone.
Daisuke...
I'm sorry...
That's why we need the Vegatron Minus Ray Gun she has.
So we shoot down that saucer and take the ray gun.
Yes. Please, lend me your strength!
I won't allow it. You'll all be frozen solid right here!
What'd ya say!?
Whoaaa! Wh-What is this?
The reservoir around the base froze in an instant...!
I almost got frozen solid. What the heck did you do!?
Hey, even the water flowing over that dam is frozen.
(...It's still not enough...
Being able to freeze water in an instant...
is of no use at all...
This won't cool a red, burning planet and make it fit for people to live on...)
Heh, if all you do is freeze water, Mazinger Z can do that too!
Freezing this much water in an instant is impressive, but...
Commander! More machines approaching!
Is that the Vega Star Federation's main force?
Looks that way.
By the look of it, the Freeze Ray still isn't finished, Kirika.
I-I'm terribly sorry, Commander Zuril. Next time, I'll...
If these failures continue...
I'll have to halt development of the Freeze Ray...
N-No... Anything but that!
Oh. Looks like they're arguing about something.
Completing the Freeze Ray is my... no, my brother's dream.
Then you'll have to show me results worthy of it...
Yes...
(She has a brother too? Then my wish to save my brother Duke...
my brother Duke...!)
Looks like our enemies are all set too.
Cover the units damaged in the fight with Mykene,
and defeat the Vega Star Federation.
Please! The Vegatron Minus Ray Gun you have...
I really, really need it!!
You followed me all the way from the moon, didn't you?
Why? Does Duke Fleed matter that much to you?
Yes! He matters! He's the only brother I have!!
You said it earlier... that it's your brother's dream?
Then you know how I feel, wanting to save my brother, don't you?
Maria! Don't do anything reckless!
(Duke Fleed and this girl are brother and sister...)
With that ray gun, my brother's body will go back to normal, right?
Please... save my brother, please save him!
Huh!? Didn't she just drop something?
That's...!? The Vegatron Minus Ray Gun...?
Did she... do that on purpose?
She might have... To think there's someone like her in Vega's forces...
With that, your body will go back to normal, Daisuke?
Yes... Now I can fight the invaders who threaten Earth...
What exactly can that thing do?
With this, I can wipe out the Vegatron radiation eating away at my body.
...I'll be able to fight alongside everyone again...!
Thank you...
Hmph, the Gandor squad, said to be the strongest on Earth...
It seems you won't go down so easily.
He's running away, the creep!
Today was just to size you up.
But the next time we meet will be your end!
Come at us as many times as you like!
This Gandor squad will never lose to the likes of you!
That's the Ninja Warrior...!
Hm, what!? What is this little runt!?
...Tobikage!
Come to think of it... we still don't know what this robot really is.
We're counting on you! Tobikage!
...Tobikage... can't you... save Joe...?
It seems all enemy forces have withdrawn.
Man. Daisuke and Maria showing up out of nowhere really surprised me.
Yeah. The lake freezing was a surprise too, though...
Still, Daisuke and Maria showing up was quite a surprise.
I never expected to run into Daisuke in a place like this.
You've got catching up to do, and we're back at the Far East branch.
Why not talk it over inside the base?
Indeed. The Gandor will be loading supplies.
Everyone, take a rest for a while.
